question: For which languages do they build word embeddings for?
title: Incorporating Subword Information into Matrix Factorization Word Embeddings
answer_rationale: The document explicitly states in section 'Subword LexVec' (Text 6, source_id=32) that they compare two types of subwords: simple n-grams and unsupervised morphemes.
